async def act(page):
    # Try to find and click a link to the members page
    try:
        # First, try to find a link with exact name 'Members'
        members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members', exact=True)
        await members_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    except:
        try:
            # If not found, try case-insensitive substring match
            members_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Members', exact=False)
            await members_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        except:
            # Search through all links for 'member' in name or URL
            all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
            count = await all_links.count()
            for i in range(count):
                link = all_links.nth(i)
                # Get the link's name or text content
                name = await link.text_content() or ''
                href = await link.get_attribute('href') or ''
                if 'member' in name.lower() or 'member' in href.lower():
                    await link.click()
                    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                    break
            else:
                # If no member link found, raise an error
                raise Exception('Could not find members link on the page')
